display_name: 大型时频网络源域 GPU 前向分段计时
description: 以非零输出头检查完整模型前向字节一致性，定位输入处理、FFT、时域与频域网络和 IFFT 的 GPU 同步耗时。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 GPU2, FP32 TF32off, deterministic; same CPU-staged legal source inputs

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 128 fixed legal source fit IDs x one source simulation view; received/anchor/innovation/variance/clean IQ and frozen direct proposal
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: First 128 IDs of existing ordered 32768 legal source fit IDs, one source simulation view
data.validation_ref: Identical source IDs, initial model, ordering and flow-time seeds per paired path

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only synchronized GPU forward phase timings; no target, identity, full-training parity or trained model claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh seed 2026110830 CrossExpertRefiner with fixed Gaussian nonzero output heads (std .001); frozen legal DURA/direct for source smoke
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed DURA source provenance and exact ordered 32768 source IDs; no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source-only DURA and source context verified
checkpoint.selection_rule: One warmup, one reference and two timed bytewise-compared forwards on identical source inputs; no trained checkpoint

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 at least 8192 MiB free and fewer than 3 total compute apps; at most one this-task GPU worker; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on incorrect source contract/GPU, nonfinite computation or trajectory mismatch; preserve artifacts

expected_artifacts: result.json: exact loss/model/optimizer/RNG comparisons and paired N607 timings

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.purpose: Locate forward stage associated with measured prolonged training steps
rows.seed_notes: Same model seed 2026110830 and order seed 2026110831 for each path.
rows.scenario: 128 fixed source records, one simulation view
rows.budget_ref: 128 source IDs, one warmup, one reference and two instrumented forwards; no backward, update or checkpoint
expected_artifacts: result.json: exact loss/model/optimizer/RNG comparisons and paired N607 timings

notes: Only legal source cache and frozen source DURA/direct; no F/TX/V/target reads, model updates or saved weights.
